headline: Contested Fronts Stir Along the War Line
war_summary: Since the last edition, MarbanHollow has become the liveliest renewed front, rising to 36 strategic-base events in the rolling day and six in the latest two hours; its holdings now stand at four Colonial, two Warden, and two neutral positions. Godcrofts has also surged, recording 11 events in two hours and 20 in the day, with three Warden and six Colonial bases. PalantineBerm remains heavily contested, reaching 53 daily events and ten in the latest two hours, while its seven bases comprise four Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral. StlicanShelf has quickened to five events in two hours and 13 across the day, with one Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanse remains a costly, unsettled sector—48 events in the day and two recently—with five Warden and four neutral bases. LinnMercy, by contrast, has gone quiet in the latest two hours after 34 daily events, retaining nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. Elsewhere, CallahansPassage and FarranacCoast show sharp combat and enlistment acceleration despite limited recorded base movement.
